title: Nitroito's Tooltips
description: A complete costumization of your tooltips... choose what to display and how
body:
A minecraft mod that improves the information displayed on tooltips. Fully customizable via ClothConfig. ## Features - Enchantments with difterent colors in order to reflect Rarity and Levels - Armor Trims with icon for the template as also material - Banner patterns with icon for the pattern and color for each layer - BeeNest/Beehive bees and honey information using icons - Bucket of Entity with full entity info as also a model preview - Show item durability using values or a gradient progress bar - Food nutrition, saturation and effects, including attribute modifiers - Maps with preview, ID, scale, dimension and coordinates - Painting with preview, size and author - Potions and Tipped arrows with attribute modifiers ## Links **Source**: https://github.com/Nitroito/Nitroito-Tooltips
**Issues**: https://github.com/Nitroito/Nitroito-Tooltips/issues --- *This project is licensed under the MIT License.*
